_comment: Hand-authored polygons for the frontal key, read off docs/concepts/pause-until-dawn/prototype-v2/art/keys/frontal.png at native pixel resolution against the landmark set in ../../landmarks/frontal.json. Fed to tools/gen/rig-cut.py layer/overlay. Coordinates are polygon vertices in the 832x1216 source canvas, closed automatically.

layers.name: body
layers.note: Shoulders, hood/collar, neck. Pinned: the runtime never moves this layer except the shared breathing sway.

layers.name: headCore
layers.note: Face skin, ears, hairline; the part of the moving head assembly that is skin, not hair. Eye apertures are cut separately and subtracted here so the iris/pupil layers can be composited independently on top.

layers.name: eyeApertureR
layers.note: Her right (green) eye opening: sclera + lids, per landmarks eyeOuter_R/eyeInner_R/eyeTop_R/eyeBottom_R. Cut as its own layer so the iris can travel inside it. The iris disc is punched out (subtract) so this layer is sclera+lids only; the hole behind a travelling iris is then filled by `rig-cut.py fillhole` (cheap neighbour-clone, per the brief's own allowed alternative to a diffusion inpaint for this case) rather than left transparent.

layers.name: eyeApertureL
layers.note: Her left (blue) eye opening, mirrored geometry from the plate's own asymmetry. Iris punched out, same reasoning as eyeApertureR.

layers.name: irisR
layers.note: Her right (green) iris + pupil disc only, cut tight so it can travel inside eyeApertureR.

layers.name: hairFront
layers.note: The fringe/bangs over the forehead, in front of headCore in z-order.

layers.name: strand1
layers.note: Loose pink-tipped strand crossing the near/green-eye cheek, its own moving layer per the brief.

layers.name: strand2
layers.note: Loose strand on the far/blue-eye side.

layers.name: hairBack
layers.note: Everything else in the hair silhouette: the bulk of the side/back hair mass, behind headCore and the strands in z-order. Cut last so its subtract list punches out every other hair-region layer, leaving no double-covered pixels.

layers.name: earring
layers.note: The braid, beads and tassel hanging from her right ear. Its own layer so it can lag on its own spring like the hair does.
